general_information.name: UH, MY NAME? I MEAN, I THINK YOU’RE ASKING FOR THE FULL ONE ON THE PAPERS AND STUFF, BUT I’M NOT SURE WHAT PART YOU WANT FIRST. PEOPLE USUALLY CALL ME WYATT, AND—SORRY, I’M KIND OF MIXING THAT UP WITH MY SCHOOL THINGS. COULD YOU SAY IT ANOTHER WAY?

current_concerns.primary_problems: It’s mostly the anger stuff… I get these temper outbursts and I’m irritable a lot, and then I end up in fights at home and school. I got suspended too, which was… yeah. I want to stop getting so angry, and maybe have more friends and do better in school, but the anger is the big one.
current_concerns.goals: Um… I’m not totally sure how to say it. I guess, like, I want things to be less messy at school and at home, if that makes sense? I’m sort of thinking out loud here, sorry. Could you maybe ask it in a simpler way?

past_psychiatric_history.assessment_details: When I was 10, by Dr. Raj Patel, the child psychiatrist.
past_psychiatric_history.previous_therapies: Yeah… I did behavioural therapy when I was around 10 to 11. It was at an outpatient clinic, and I think there were about 12 sessions, maybe around that.; Um, age 10 to 11, I think.; About 12 sessions.

medications.current_medications: Medication 1: Name Or Description: Methylphenidate short-acting.; Dose: It’s the small morning one… and then a noon one too. I think the morning is 10 mg and the noon one is 5 mg.; Start Or Duration: September 2024.; Side Effects: My appetite’s worse at lunch. Like I don’t feel like eating much then.

personal_history.early_childhood: Uh… I don’t know about the born part. I was just a kid, and I was irritable even then, with outbursts. That’s the main thing I remember, honestly.
personal_history.adolescence_early_adulthood: I’m in grade 6, so it’s mostly school difficulties. The big thing is school being hard because of the anger and… yeah, the inattention/impulsivity stuff from before, I guess. I don’t really have jobs or anything like that.
personal_history.significant_relationships: I don’t have any romantic relationships to talk about.
personal_history.future_goals: I want more friends, and to do better in school, and to get a handle on my anger. That’s pretty much it.
